title: Just in Case
text: Before the shuttles lift, the Archivist hands you a drive. Not a copy for the shuttle: a copy for you. "Everything. The Ledger. Every report we ever sent, with the margin field left in. Kindred's archive, Engram's. The Vell's songs, transcribed. The Teth dish codes."

lines.text: "If you get there and find you don't have to break it. Just in case. It's an argument. It's the best one I've got."

notes: The hidden ending's gate (STORY.md §17), checked at home where planet health and acceptance live: planet ≥ 70, acceptance ≥ 60, kindred-ally, ledger-read, long-ear, the Vell trusted (keeper-song) and the Choir (choir-fragment), Engram not destroyed (unless). Sets proof-ready, which the Lantern's seize choice reads.
